slug: 御兽我契约的皆可返祖
content_zh:
海城。
沧澜高中，高三七班。
身着休闲服饰，带着眼镜的青年老师，用粉笔在黑板上写下凌沧海三个大字。
“我是你们这学期的班主任，本学期我们主要学习培养御兽以及如何使用御兽进行战斗。”
“你们面前有一块觉醒石，用来帮助你们觉醒自身的御兽天赋，只要将你们的一滴血滴在觉醒石上，再用手握住觉醒石，就可以进行御兽师天赋觉醒了。”
凌沧海伸手推了推眼镜，目光从众人面前的觉醒石上一一扫过。
而坐在下方的学生们，也有人开始按照凌沧海所说的方法进行御兽师天赋觉醒，一颗颗觉醒石散发淡淡光芒，有的是白色光芒，有的是绿色光芒，还有少数是蓝色的光芒。
“今年又没有什么好苗子吗？”
“也是，七班属于有名的差班，有几名c级天赋学生已经很不错了。”
凌沧海在心中呢喃着。
御兽师天赋由高到低分为：s、a、b、c、d、e，六个等级。
c级天赋，已经是不错的天赋了，属于是比上不足，但比下有余的程度。
教室的一个角落中。
身着黑色短裙，气质偏冷的夜离殇，在观察完其他同学觉醒御兽师天赋后，就将目光放在自己的觉醒石上，用指尖划破手指，挤出一滴嫣红的鲜血，滴在觉醒石上。
做完这一切，夜离殇就伸手握住觉醒石。
握住觉醒石的瞬间，夜离殇就感觉有一股温和的暖流顺着手臂进入身体中，让她的身体逐渐炽热起来，就仿佛有什么恐怖的力量在体内觉醒一样。
觉醒石散发出淡淡的金色光芒，光芒愈发强盛起来。
“咦？”
“我这是出金了吗？”
看着散发出金色光芒的觉醒石，夜离殇的心中才刚刚出现这个想法，眼眸就不自觉地闭合起来，属于她的御兽天赋出现在脑海中。

s级天赋：时光回溯—能够看到御兽的返祖血脉，战斗时使用时光回溯，可让所契约的御兽短暂回归返祖状态，从而大幅度提高战斗能力，返祖状态可持续五分钟，每天可使用三次，超过次数限制将对御兽和御兽师的身体造成损伤，可通过提升御兽师本身的实力，提高返祖状态的时间。
“s级天赋？”
“顶级御兽师的苗子！”
“摆脱差班的名头，升职加薪，似乎有希望了！”
凌沧海推了一下眼镜，目光看着夜离殇的方向，眼眸逐渐闪亮起来。
那眼神就仿佛看到了一条充满光明的道路正在向自己招手一样。
“s级天赋！”
“天呐，居然是s级天赋。”
“真是羡慕，这可是最顶级的御兽师天赋了。”
教室中渐渐出现窃窃私语的声音。
“可恶！”
“怎么偏偏她是s级天赋。”
坐在前排的洛星燃回头看向夜离殇的方向，在低声呢喃的同时轻轻咬住下唇，目光中露出不服和嫉妒的神色
“安静。”
凌沧海轻轻吐出两个字，在让教室安静下来后，便往夜离殇的方向走去。
他来到夜离殇的身旁站下，但却并没有打扰夜离殇，而是安静的等待起来。
时间渐渐流逝。
几分钟后，夜离殇的眼眸缓缓睁开，松开了紧握的觉醒石，嘴角不自觉的勾起一个弧度。
content_en:
Haicheng.
Canglan High School, Class 7, Grade 3.
A young teacher wearing casual clothes and glasses wrote the three characters Ling Canghai on the blackboard with chalk.
"I am your class teacher this semester. This semester we mainly study how to train beasts and how to use them to fight."
"There is an awakening stone in front of you to help you awaken your own beast master talent. Just drop a drop of your blood on the awakening stone, and then hold the awakening stone with your hand to awaken the beast master talent."
Ling Canghai stretched out his hand to push up his glasses, and his eyes swept over the awakening stones in front of everyone.
Among the students sitting below, some began to awaken the beast master's talent according to the method described by Ling Canghai. The awakening stones emitted a faint light, some were white light, some were green light, and a few were blue light.
"Are there no good seeds this year?"
"Yes, Class 7 is a famously bad class, and there are a few C-level talented students who are already pretty good."
Ling Canghai murmured in his heart.
Beast master's talents are divided into six levels from high to low: s, a, b, c, d, e.
C-level talent is already a good talent. It is not as good as those above, but more than enough.
In a corner of the classroom.
Ye Lishang, who was wearing a black short skirt and had a cold temperament, after observing other students awakening their talents as beast masters, turned his attention to his own awakening stone, cut his finger with his fingertips, squeezed out a drop of bright red blood, and dripped it on the awakening stone.
After doing all this, Ye Li Shang reached out and held the awakening stone.
The moment she held the Awakening Stone, Ye Lishang felt a gentle warm current flowing down her arms and into her body, making her body gradually heat up, as if some terrifying power was awakening in her body.
The awakening stone emits a faint golden light, and the light becomes stronger and stronger.
"Huh?"
"Am I withdrawing money?"
Looking at the awakening stone emitting golden light, this idea just appeared in Ye Lishang's mind, her eyes closed unconsciously, and her talent for controlling beasts appeared in her mind.
S-level talent: Time Retrospect—Be able to see the ancestral bloodline of the beast master. Using time rewind during battle can allow the contracted beast master to return to the ancestral state for a short time, thereby greatly improving the combat ability. The ancestral state can last for five minutes and can be used three times a day. Exceeding the limit will cause damage to the body of the beast master and the beast master. By improving the strength of the beast master himself, the time of the atavism state can be increased.
"S-level talent?"
"The son of a top beastmaster!"
"There seems to be hope for getting rid of the reputation of poor class and getting a promotion and salary increase!"
Ling Canghai pushed up his glasses and looked in Ye Lishang's direction, his eyes gradually shining.
His eyes seemed to see a bright road waving to him.
"S-level talent!"
"Oh my god, it's actually an S-level talent."
"I'm really envious. This is the top talent of a beast master."
Whispers gradually appeared in the classroom.
"Damn it!"
"Why does she have an S-level talent?"
Luo Xingran, who was sitting in the front row, turned back to look in Ye Lishang's direction, biting his lower lip gently while murmuring, with a look of dissatisfaction and jealousy in his eyes.
"Quiet."
Ling Canghai uttered two words softly, and after quieting the classroom, he walked in the direction of Ye Lishang.
He came to stand next to Ye Lishang, but did not disturb Ye Lishang, but waited quietly.
Time passes gradually.
A few minutes later, Ye Lishang's eyes slowly opened, he loosened his grip on the Awakening Stone, and the corners of his mouth curled up unconsciously.
